bio: Situated in the fashionable district of Knightsbridge, Le Chinois Restaurant and Bar offers guests modern Chinese cuisine in an exclusive setting on Sloane Street. Le Chinois is celebrated for its authentic, yet innovative, Cantonese cuisine.  The Afternoon Tea menu has been carefully invented by Le Chinois' head chef to create a unique and memorable experience.  Their Traditional English Afternoon Tea features sumptuous sandwiches, including smoked salmon & crème fraiche and cucumber & mint yoghurt, as well as a selection of handmade sweets and fancies. All of this is served alongside your choice of tea and, if you're feeling indulgent, a chilled glass of Champagne or Prosecco!
